name: Locator / UI change
description: Element not found - likely a changed accessibility id or screen layout. Check target/locator-drift-report.json and verify with Appium MCP.

name: Business rule violation (probable product bug)
description: The app behaved, but not as specified: wrong order, filter leak, details mismatch.

name: Synchronisation / performance
description: A condition did not happen within the timeout: slow backend, missing loader, or animation.

name: Infrastructure (Appium / WDA / simulator)
description: Session could not be created or was lost. Not a product signal.

name: Test data / configuration
description: Missing credentials, unknown dataset alias or invalid config.
